Ugh, I should never have volunteered to be a specialist. They always ask us to do the impossible!
Uhnhh.... Don't... bother with me.$b$bI am... finished...
Uhnhh.... Don't... bother with me.$b$bI am... finished....
Unlucky name fer a sailor, innit?
Until I traveled through Nagrand and came to the forest, I feared that too much of our original culture was lost. I'm thankful to see that I was wrong.$B$BThere is so much to be done here!
Until you have mastered the Apprentice level of Jewelcrafting we shall not speak again.
Urrrk... if that grubbing galley chief over there offers you his special, do yourself a favor and dump it in the ocean. It might kill a few makruras instead of your will to live.
Us no like paladins. Elf lady come to city, stay in Royal Quarter. Her paladin. You talk, learn paladin things.
Us starting ta like little $N!  Yous bashem da demons real good!
Used by the Barov family of the Scholomance as a mirror into the souls that they no longer possess. A valuable keepsake.
Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a warrior worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

Varos Cloudstrider and his ring guardians protect the second ring.  Your drakes are more than a match for the Ring Guardians, but Varos stands behind an impenetrable shield created from the energy of the Oculus itself.  Ten Centrifuge Constructs power the shield from the ring and platforms above.  Destroy them and Varos will be vulnerable.$B$BI can grant you the power to call upon a drake from the Red Fight.  Speak to Eternos or Verdisa if you prefer to draw on the power of the Bronze or the Green.
Very good $N.  You will find Grizzle Halfmane in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity.  May you find great honor in Alterac Valley.

Very well, but if I were you, I would pay attention and not just blindly nod my head at what I heard.$B$BIt begins, as all good stories do, with betrayal. Oh, it's not that we were betrayed... not at all. The Lich King raised us death knights above all others.$B$BRather, it was we who betrayed him with the help of Highlord Darion Mograine.$B$BIn the final fight at Light's Hope Chapel in the Plaguelands, with the simpletons moments away from annihilation, Tirion Fordring helped Mograine break the Lich King's hold upon him and all of the rest of us that were present.
Very well, let's go!
Very well. It is done.
Vesprystus' hippogryphs will bear you swiftly to your destination.
Vol'jin told me ta keep hittin' da drum till he gets back.  If ya be waitin' for him, he'd be back soon to take back da Isles.$B$BJust wait here and enjoy da music!
Vrykuls is bigger and stronger than us.  But we is better looking!
WAIT $c! Your search for the next boss isn't this way. Try another way.
Wait, $g brother:m'lady;....$b$bOne last thing...
Wait, don't tell me... $n, right?$b$bWhat can I do for you?$B
Walk always in the Light, $N.
Walk in the Light, my child.
Walking down the street! Looking at my feet! Watching the leaves, fall off of the trees!
Want to train with Borgus? Aye, I can tell ye where to find him. Head through the Square northwest of me forge, then take the western road. Ye'll find him in the second building on yer right.
Want us to help with something? What we help with? We good at helping.
Wanted DEAD for treason and other treacherous acts against the Horde!$B$BAll bounties paid by Captain Gort.
Warsong Gulch you say?  Well then, you'll be wanting to speak with fair Lylandris over in the Hall of Arms.

Watch your step aboard Elune's Blessing, $r.  Though Elune's blessed us with the discovery of our new friends, we've also had our share of hardships at sea.$b$bHowever, recovering souls lost at sea or lost in a new world is truly a blessing from Elune.
We Thunderbrews take pride knowing that we are the best brewhouse in all the realms.
We already have control of Twin Spire Ruins! Get out there and defend it!
We already have control of Twin Spire Ruins! Get out there and defend it!
We are a people without a home to call our own now.
We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.
We are free of the Headless Horseman's terror, for now.  We may breathe easy again, but until he can be defeated while joined with his head, he may return.
We are here to help.
We are launching an assault on Bash'ir Landing, to study their Crystalforge.  Help us if you can!  Our Skyguard Aether-tech will leave in about $4581d.
We are lucky to have survived this ordeal. If it wasn't for you, everyone on this island could have been killed!

We are most pleased with your actions against the night elves. When you uncovered their plot to use the ley-line nexi and their so-called moon crystals to spy upon us, you strengthened our position here by an order of magnitude.$B$BYou have our gratitude, $N.
We are one in the Light, $g brother : sister;, but I cannot train you.

We are quickly learning the price of death in this frigid wasteland, $N. The Lich King's power extends across every inch of Northrend, permeating into the earth itself! He turns our own fallen people against us.$B$BFrom the sky, risen gryphon riders rain down their vengeful stormhammers as the walking dead assail us on the ground.$B
We are safe... for now. His strength has increased tenfold since our last battle. It will take a mighty army to destroy the Lich King. An army greater than even the Horde can rouse.
We are trying to bring Agamath, the First Gate down. Please, $c, go to the Isle of Quel'Danas and help in any way that you can!
We are very fortunate to be alive, you and I!
We cannot allow the Alliance to turn the hidden secrets of the Strand of the Ancients against us. Will you join our brave warriors there?
We cannot allow the Horde to turn the hidden secrets of the Strand of the Ancients against us. Will you join our brave soldiers there?

We cannot thank you enough for everything you've done to protect our family, $N.$B$BAnd, you do realize that we were joking before when we offered to sell you one of our sons?  No, really... although we do feel a couple more headaches coming on.$B$BJunior, be still, will you?!
We compete not only for glory, but to bring honor to our ancestors and to our people.

We discovered these proto-drakes at the Bronze Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight. We knew at once that they were kin - our blood from ages past.$B$BMy apologies, $c. You are probably confused. I am Penumbrius of the bronze dragonflight. I have taken this form out of convenience. It is much easier to communicate and live amongst mortals while in the mortal guise.$B$BHow can I help you?$B
We do not have much time, hero. What do you need?
We don't have any easy path before us. If you've got a strong arm on you, stick around until one of my squads is ready to ascend to Ymirheim. They could use all the help they can get.
We got the final barrier blockin' entry to Frostwing Halls down, $g lad:lass;. Only Sindragosa stands between the Lich King and divine retribution! What are ye waitin' for?!
We have a lot of excess supplies, but we still need more before we can send an assualt into the Field of Strife.
We have a lot of supplies, but we still need a lot more in order to send a ground assault into the Field of Strife.
We have been tending these worms for some time. I hope they will be fit in time for the ring event of this organization. You must face not one, but two jormungar, after all.
We have excess supplies, but not many.  We'll need a lot more before we can send a ground assault into the Field of Strife.
We have gained control of the armory, but our work on the island is not yet finished.
We have little to discuss, $c. Perhaps you should seek other, more like-minded individuals.
We have no time to waste, $c. Why do you delay here?
We have quite the feast for you friend.
We have some supplies, but not many.  We'll need a lot more in order to send a ground assault into the Field of Strife.
We hope you'll be able to ease our headaches.  You try having ten sons, all of them wanting to do something they weren't meant for!$B$BStill, as a father, we do what we must.
We know that the wyrmcultists are massing on the other side of the tunnel.  We'll make our stand here.
We may be working together, but that only increases the need for discretion. Once again, be mindful of your words and actions.$B$BI can guarantee we're far from the only ones out here.
We may operate in the shadows of polite society, but out here on the battlefront our powers are properly respected at last.
We must continue to hold on for as long as we can! Fight on!
We must discover what's behind the mystery of the giant crystal that fell from the heavens on Fallen Sky Ridge.

We must eliminate the elves and their cowardly Alliance from Warsong Gulch.  Go to the Hall of the Brave in the Valley of Honor and speak with Brakgul Deathbringer if you have what it takes to aid the Horde.
We must first craft a prison to confine the beast, if you wish to progress further.

We must maintain a state of vigilance, $c! Between Dar'Khan the Betrayer and his Scourge, and the Shadowpine trolls backed by the might of Zul'Aman, we're barely keeping our heads above water here. We really shouldn't have to be dividing our attentions!$B$BI hope you're here to help.
We must make sure not to lose any more souls to the seas.
We must re-establish our stranglehold on these mines!
We must resist!  Gird your soul!  Burn the foul plague wherever you find it!
We must search for survivors. If anyone is still alive, we must at least try and get them back...
We must succceed! Azeroth's fate lies in the balance....

We mustn't lose our focus. The dangers inherent in getting lost in the moment could put us in peril. Alas, the soldiers need a respite from this madness.$B$BBask in the victory, $N. If not for you we might have lost the Vanguard.
We need to figure out what this shadowy group is doing here at Grangol'var Village!
We need to get this outpost ready for the push into Sholazar Basin.$B$BDon't just stand there, $c. Go out and represent the Horde with honor and spilled blood!

We plaguebringers tend to be slightly more practical than the average apothecary.  After all, we deal with the logistics of deploying the plague.$B$BThat doesn't mean our theoretical background isn't rock solid.  We just prefer... hands on tasks.
We practitioners of the arcane and elemental ways follow a never ending path of discovery. Is that why you seek my counsel? You wish further training?
We protect this airship on its way from Orgrimmar to Grom'gol base camp in Stranglethorn Vale.
We really must perfect a way to deal with those smelly Shadowpine trolls!

We require da help of allies on da islands.$B$BZen'tabra has been watching over da animals of de Islands for some time now.  We'd need her help and da help of da animal creatures.$B$BBwonsamdi is a powerful loa dat controls de spirits of de dead on da islands.  His blessing is crucial for our attack.$B$BOnce our allies have joined us, Zalazane and his army of mind-controlled trolls will have no chance!  Then, da Echo Isles will be de Darkspears!
We serve Thorim, sister.
We serve the light unquestioningly. Perhaps you might be a bit more curious about our purpose?
We set up this area to practice fire fighting.  You never know when the town will be imperiled!
We shall be in your debt $c.  Look for Donal Osgood in the Hall of Arms.  He will be more than happy to aid you in your journey to Arathi Basin.
We still go through the motions, but the feast of Winter Veil feels empty now. In Orgrimmar they have the true celebration.
We succeeded in taking the Sanctum.  We can continue to convert sentries and use them as guards at other tactical locations.

We want everyone to have fun at Brewfest.  It would also help if we had some people remember it as well.$b$bThese goggles allow anyone to experience what it's like to be drunk, but without the drinking part.  Put the goggles on, and you're drunk!  Take them off, and you're sober!$b$bAre you interested in a pair?
We will fight when you are ready, $N.
We will ravage the living... I mean the Scourge, of course.$B

We wish that we could create more than one darkrune in a day, but that would be a waste of time.  It's simply not physically possible.  Besides, we can't even reliably create them at that rate.$B$BAnd trust us, if there were anyone else here smart enough to help, they'd be conscripted and we'd have as many darkrunes as needed.
We wouldn't have crashed if Hemet could learn how to avoid shooting through the ailerons when he's trying to bag game on the ground!$B$BNo worries though, I'll have her fixed up quick enough.

We'd be gettin' ready to take back da Echo Isles. Zalazane has been workin' his voodoo magic for some time, convincing folks dat he be dead and performing ancient dark rituals.$B$BHe knows we'd be coming, so we have ta make sure we be prepared.
We'll get to the bottom of this massacre if it's the last thing we do!

We'll start in just a moment.$B$BI just want to be very clear -- we're not here to soften them up. We're not here to make a dent. We're here to put an end to the disease that calls itself the Scarlet Onslaught.$B$BIf you don't want any part of that, if you don't have the stomach, fly away now. I want someone with us who is going to be here every day until the job's done.$B$BAre you that $g man : woman;, $N?
We'll take over from here, you've earned quite a respite after that battle.
We're almost ready to depart. Just give us a little bit longer to finish our preparations.
We're always eager for more flight data!  Where do you want to go?

We're building another road down into Stormwind Harbor as soon as this wall has been removed... but this mad dwarf brought enough powder to level the entire quarter!$B$BI don't know what Master Alexston was thinking when he hired her... she's foul-mouthed, mean, and stubborn as an ox!
We're celebrating spring during Noblegarden. Affirmation of life and all that.
We're celebrating the who breaking free of the what? Bah, who cares?! More candy!
We're currently focus testing the Battle of Mount Hyjal. You must have at least HONORED reputation with the Violet Eye to participate.$B$BThat's the reputation you gain while doing Karazhan.
We're holding Lord Jaraxxus back for now, but we can't keep him bound for much longer.
We're in a fine mess here.
We're in over our heads, $r! Watch your back!
We're making progress, $r, but far too slowly.
We're miners, farmers and craftsmen - not soldiers.  But we'll defend our land with our bare fists if we must.

We're putting the final preparations together even as we speak.  The rest will depend upon how quickly you can organize your forces at Ruuan Weald.$B$BDo you think that you can handle that and get it done quickly?
We're still making preparations. We won't be ready to go for a while.
We're too merciful with the Wretched.  We ought to drive a sword through each of them.$B$BTheir boldness in Sunsail Anchorage is unpardonable.

We're tryin' ta blow this wall so Wick's men can work on the new Harbor gatehouse and road beyond, but the clueless sod is cryin' about me using too much powder!$B$BTch. I've been sappin' since he was in diapers. This goes on much longer, I'll kick him into the canal and finish the whole blasted job meself!
We've a duty out here, $g boy : girl;, to see to it that we don't let anyone surprise us.$B$BThat means proactive action!
We've almost consolidated our control over Sun's Reach.  If we manage to keep the harbor from getting any reinforcements we will certainly succeed.$B$BWe are $3238w percent done with our goal.
We've captured the armory, $N.  Let's not rest on our laurels, however.  The Legion sure will not.

We've come to the Ruuan Weald to see if we can reestablish the balance of nature to these mountains.$B$BThe interference of the arakkoa and the wyrmcult is making this a difficult task, however.$B$BLuckily, there are those like you and Samia that are willing to lend us a hand.
We've done it, $N.  Mar'nah has learned how to transmute very special gems.  And I've learned how to work them.
We've done it, $N.  With Sun's Reach under our control we are but mere moments away from absolute victory.
We've got to get those supply crates back!
We've important work to do, $N.  Let us attack our enemies while their guard is down.  Let us show them that sin'dorei vengeance never forgets nor forgives.
We've just arrived here and already we've buried too many of our friends and comrades.
We've lost a few good people up here already. I'm beginning to doubt that this place is worth our attention.

We've lost a good many of our wind riders on scouting missions to the west. The Scourge is ruthless in their assault against any would-be spies.$B$BFortunately, I've come up with a solution that only risks the life of the rider. It's seen a 30% survival rate to those being ferried across the Plains of Nasam. That's a 30% improvement over when we were using wind riders!
We've managed to squeeze through Thunder Bluff twice now!
We've recently heard word of a creature of immense power being summoned near the Vector Coil. Fear not, should anything threaten the town, we will give our lives to protect it.
We've sworn to do our very best to protect the passengers of The Bravery. The sea lane between Auberdine to Stormwind Harbor must remain safe.

We've taken the harbor, and this ship is a nice bonus. Too bad she's not yet sea-worthy.$B$BIn the meantime, I've been instructed to oversee the disruption of the naga on the Greengill Coast.$B$BThink you can help me out?
Welcome aboard $c.  Take a load off and enjoy the trip.  Aboard "The Purple Princess" we want you to relax.  We have vending machines down below if there's anything you might need while aboard.
Welcome aboard the Maiden's Fancy. It should be smooth sailing all the way to port.
Welcome back, $N.
Welcome friend! What would you like to see?
Welcome to Camp Oneqwah.
Welcome to Eco-Dome Midrealm, traveler. I would warn you to be wary of dealing with that goblin, Shauly. I don't believe I've ever heard anyone use the word "buddy" as punctuation before.
Welcome to Fairbreeze Village.  Silvermoon's all but given up on us, but we refuse to leave.  This is our home.

Welcome to Falcon Watch, $c. I see to the needs of the pilgrims and help them in continuing their long journey. If you haven't yet undertaken the pilgrimage, I can provide you with the information you will need.
Welcome to Forest Song, $c. If there is anything I can do for you, please let me know.
Welcome to Garadar, stranger. Are you looking for a place to rest?

Welcome to Ogri'la, $c.$B$BThe ogres here have managed to gain a great mental acuity through the magical emanations of the surrounding crystals.  Though we do not fully understand how they work, we have come to appreciate our new home and only want to live in peace.$B$BUnfortunate then that the demons and ethereals, and especially the Black Dragonflight, will not leave us to that peace.
Welcome to The Bravery, $gsir:madame;. Now if you'll excuse me...
Welcome to Theramore, $c.

Welcome to Tranquillien, $c. I apologize for the state that you find it in. As you can see, we've been having some trouble, but the Forsaken, and their Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, have been gracious enough to lend us a great deal of assistance in our time of need.$B$BIf you can lend a hand please do not hesitate to do so. We can use all of the help that we can get in our struggle against the myriad forces arrayed against us.
Welcome to Zabra'jin, $c. I am Shadow Hunter Denjai, overseer of this outpost and commander of the Darkspear forces in Zangarmarsh.
Welcome to me camp, $r.$b$bShe don't look like much, but she's home fer now.
Welcome to my kitchen! We prepare some of the finest food in Dalaran here.
Welcome to our camp, $c. You're free to rest here if you'd like.
Welcome to our shop.  We have everything you need... if you need alchemy supplies.
Welcome to the Allerian Stronghold, $N.
Welcome to the Bank of Silvermoon, $g sir : ma'am;. Would you care to access the depository?
Welcome to the Cenarion Refuge, $n. I've been instructed to offer you basic supplies for purchase, should you need them.
Welcome to the Evergrove, $c. Timeon and I have been studying the arakkoa of Blade's Edge for some time now, and we've found some alarming differences between them and their cousins in Terokkar.
Welcome to the Falconwing Square Inn. May I prepare a meal for you, or ready a room?
Welcome to the Farstrider Retreat.  We are rangers sworn to defend our people from enemies both near and far.
Welcome to the Registrar of Guilds.  How can I be of service to you?
Welcome to the Royal Exchange Bank, $g sir : ma'am;. How may I help you?
Welcome to the Taverns of Time!
Welcome to the camp, $c.
Welcome to the headquarters of the Blood Knights, the defenders of Quel'Thalas, the faithful servants of Silvermoon, and the true masters of the Light.
Welcome!  If you need a place to rest, I can solve that problem.
Welcome! Have you come to join us for a Pilgrim's Bounty feast? Please, have a seat at a Bountiful Table.$B$BTry everything! I'm certain you'll find something to your liking.
Welcome! Have you come to join us for a Pilgrim's Bounty feast? Please, have a seat at a Bountiful Table.$B$BTry everything! I'm certain you'll find something to your liking.
Welcome! Have you yet honored this land's flame?
Welcome, $N. Bring me the marks that Illidan bestows upon his most powerful minions and I shall grant you access to my alchemical goods.
Welcome, $N. My expertise is in the art of working with primal mooncloth. Tailors interested in becoming mooncloth specialists often ask me to teach them our ways.

Welcome, $c!  I hope you aren't afraid of heights!$b$bI've got a practice parachute for you.  These chutes are for quick landings.  If you want to gently soar to the ground, use a mount.  If you want action and an adrenaline rush, you fall.  At the last possible moment you use your chute.  That's how these were made.  Quick action!  Are you ready for some quick action?$b$bThe chute only lasts a few seconds.  So you'll need to time it just right.  I'm not sure you can handle it, $c.  I'd like to see you prove me wrong.

Welcome, $c. Have you come to honor this flame?$b$bRemember: Our festival fires burn in every land with a Horde settlement. Make time to honor each of them, if you can.$b$bThe Alliance, too, burns fires of their own. You would do well to desecrate such unworthy efforts when you see them.

Welcome, $c. Have you come to honor this flame?$b$bRemember: Our festival fires burn in every land with an Alliance settlement. Make time to honor each of them, if you can.$b$bThe Horde, too, burns fires of their own. You would do well to desecrate such unworthy efforts when you see them.
Welcome, adventurer. You've come just in the nick of time.

Welcome, champion! Have you gathered your forces in preparation for the challenges of the Trial of the Grand Crusader? Only the most powerful and accomplished of combatants are able to participate in these trials. To participate in these trials, you must have completed the normal Trial of the Crusader.

Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?$B$BWe can groom facial hair, perform piercings, reshape tusks and horns, and even modify undead features!$B$BHave a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only a few coins away from a new, more attractive you...
Welcome. May I offer you rest or sustenance?
Welcome. Will you take your rest here, or perhaps a meal?
Well I hope you improve quickly!
Well done! Your fighting against all those beasts was splendid! I hear the next challenge should be even tougher!

Well look at you. Aren't you big and tough... Maybe you think you're tough enough to step into the Ring of Blood and face the Warmaul champion?$B$B<The pitfighter laughs.>$B$BNot very likely but if you ever wanna test your strength, the Ring of Blood is far to the north against the mountains dividing Nagrand and Zangarmarsh. Gurgthock runs the show at the old Laughing Skull Ruins and he also dispenses the prizes. Speaking of prizes, I hear the prizes this season are incredible!
Well met, $c.  My advice to you is this: as you travel the world, be wary of magic for it will burn the untrained.
Well met, $c. Even now, the Horde attacks Warsong Gulch. Will you fight alongside the Alliance there?
Well met, $c. Your arrival in Thrallmar could not have occurred at a better time. The warchief is depending on us, since he cannot be here himself.
Well met, $c.$B$BI train Aspirants in the art of mounted close combat.

Well met, $r. I am here as a resource of advice for the High Executor to make use of as he will. I am confident that together we can forge the Horde into something that is even stronger than before and turn back the Scourge menace once and for all!
Well met, Battle-Sister. I can assist you in recovering lost companions.
Well met, I'm Azimi! I often make the walk out here to sell the men fresh fruit and water. Are you hungry, or perhaps thirsty?
Well met, fellow Mohawk $GBrother:Sister;.

Well then! A mounted Charge is about more than just kickin' yer mount ta full speed an' hollerin' yer lungs out... though that IS the fun part, heh! But the Charge Target will teach ye the finer points.$B$BA good Charge is all about distance and timing. Ye can't be TOO close, or ye won't get enough speed. But ye can't be too far away either or yer mount will tire! As for timin'...$B$BYe'll want ta make sure the Charge Target doesn't have a layer o' Defend up before ye rush in. If it does, use yer Shield Breaker ta make it vulnerable, and THEN Charge in!$B$BSame goes for the real thing: Try ta drop yer opponent defenses before ye Charge!
Well then, I spose I be owin' ya my thanks, $r.$b$bTruth is, I thought I'd swallowed me last tankard 'til ye showed up.
Well then, I'll give the signal to Tirion when you are ready to go.
Well this is troublesome! How am I supposed to collect the ore samples for the magisters if the mines have been overrun with gnoll vermin?
Well well, not too bad. Maybe I CAN show you a few things...
Well you're an ugly one! Don't mean you don't know how to fight though.$B$BOne of my squads should be geared and ready to march soon - get your sorry butt in line and make the climb with them!

Well, from what I've gathered while waiting to be eaten by these yokels... it might not be necessary to kill every ogre you find here.$B$BThe ogres were going on and on the other day about how King Gordok came to power; specifically, he killed the previous king and took his place.  Well, the king's henchmen - those that Gordok spared - immediately swore fealty to the new king.$B$BWho knows - the ogre you save could very well be your own... figuratively speaking, of course!
Well, you didn't come all this way out here to jaw over a cup of tea. Let's see how you might be able to help get us out of this situation.

Well, you're not going to sign recruitment papers or anything, but you are going to fight alongside him. You need to make sure Arthas culls Stratholme and defeats Mal'Ganis. Without Uther and Jaina around, he'll need all the help he can get. If you talk to Arthas, he'll put you to work destroying the forces of Mal'Ganis. Follow along until I can figure out what's going on with the Infinites. I'll contact you again when I know more.
Well. Another $c, come to learn the ways of the Shield-Breaker...?
Weve located the mark, commander. Ya-six and i have been seperated. Requesting backup.

What I offer to you now is one such blade, unfired, unheated, untreated - the most raw and basic form.$B$BNow you merely need to find a dragon that will willingly enchant the blade.$B$BIf you had an eternity to live, this might be a possibility; but since you are mortal and could very likely cease to exist at any moment, might I recommend trying to persuade one of the lesser dragons to do your bidding.

What a landmark discovery! The Royal Apothecary Society has spent years working to break the secrets of the Lich King's plague, and I've finally done it!$B$BDespite this turning point in history, there is still so much to discover. I have more experiments to conduct... test subjects to acquire...$B$BAt least I don't have to worry about Scourge necropoli. The Alliance is dealing with that problem. This leaves me plenty of time to delve into the secrets of the plague and uncover what I can.
What are ye doin' here?! Get yer chatty self ta Alterac Vallery, where ye're needed!
What are you after? Speak up. I'm not about to trust you with one of my Elekks until you prove your dedication and friendship to our people.
What are you doing all the way back here? You need to get back to Stratholme immediately! Shall I teleport you to Stratholme?

What are you doing here?  Shouldn't you be working on the energy pipeline?$B$BWe've more than doubled the amount of energy we're sending to Tempest Keep and can't afford anyone loafing.  We don't want another Ultris to happen here.
What are you doing here? Arthas is at the entrance to Stratholme right now and you should be with him! Go!
What are you doing out here?
What are you gonna do when Rulk-a-mania runs wild on you, brother????!
What are you lookin' at?
What are you looking at, $glad : lass;?  Never seen a dwarf before, then?$B$BYou'd best be on yer way if you don't want any trouble.
What are you looking for?
What are you staring at, $r?
What are you still doing here? Go back to town!
What assistance can I offer in your studies?
What battleground you want?
What be happening?$B$BYou here to eat, mon? Or maybe to learn cooking from the best, eh?
What brings you all the way up here, little $r?
What brings you here, $N?  We don't see too many people around these parts.  With good reason, I suppose.
What business brings you here, $c?
What can I be helping you with?
What can I do for you?

What can I say, $c? You're a true $g hero : heroine;! Not only have you personally saved many of my rangers, but you've dealt a decisive blow against the Shadowpine trolls. Are you sure that you don't want to stay here and be one of my Farstriders?$B$BFare well, $N.
What can a guy like me be doin' for a $r like you at a time like this?$B
What can we say, $N?  $G Dude : Dudette;, anything that we have in the store is yours to purchase!$B$BRight on!

What could I have done to give the gods cause to lash out at me with such ferocity? All that I cherished is gone - dead or destroyed. My family taken from me by the brutes of the forest. My home razed. My ship sunk.$B$BI am a broken man, stranded on a broken island.$B$BPerhaps you are you here to finish the job? Make it quick, I will not resist. Take my life, stranger; I am too cowardly to do it myself. My hand shivers... the blade will not strike true.$B

What do I care if these she-wolves and the frost giants kill each other every day?$B$BNo, no... I want Thorim to break out of his stupor and rally all his allies to retake Ulduar.$B$BThe world will be torn asunder if he fails to accomplish this!$B$BAnd of course, I'll reward you appropriately.
What do you need, $c?
What do you need?
What do you want?
What do you want?$B$BIt's a bit rude to walk up to strangers for no reason, don't you think?
What do you wish to know of Jewelcrafting?
What does it look like?  The ground is frozen like a rock!$B$BThe wheels on these meatwagons were built to go over mud at best.  We're going to need an abomination and some chains to salvage them.
What enchantments interest you today, $c?
What have you got there, $N?$B$B<Malyfous points to the unfired plate gauntlets hanging out of your pack.>
What is it that you want, $r?
What is it then? Can't you see I'm a busy dwarf?
What is it? Can't you see that I'm busy?
What is your business here, $c?
What it is that I do, of course. I brood. I lament. I hate. I plot. When that cycle is complete, I brood again. What is it you want from me? I have much on my mind.
What it means to be a Hand of Argus... We are agents of the Light. We serve without question. We die without question.
What may I do for you, $GSir:Dame;?
What mysteries of the trade can I help you uncover today?
What tasty treats can we offer you?

What you see here on this coast is not a result of the Scourge. In fact, we believe that the Scourge also fear the mist - which might be why they do not come here.$B$BYou see, the mist is alive, friend. Inside those airy tendrils lies death...$B$BShould you step within its grasp, you will vanish. The mist will take you!$B$BWe have never seen anyone return alive from the mist.
What'll it be, sweety?

What's an "Ologist?" A better question might be what isn't an "Ologist." It means I study everything! In fact, I'm so well versed in "everything" that I'm guaranteed to be the most intelligent ethereal you'll ever meet - or your money back.$B$BApologies. That's the dealer in me talking...
What's happening?
What's it going to be, then?  Rum?  Ale?$B$BOr perhaps something else?
What's wrong, bonebag? Looking for someone else? I'm all you've got now, so if you want something, make it quick.
What's your pleasure?  Pull up a seat and knock one back.$B$BI'm Boots, lead mixologist for B.O.O.M. and bartender extraordinaire!$B$BIf it's got kick, Ol' Boots can give it to ya.
What? I'm busy here.
What? You want to train under me, $c? You better be ready to work.
What?!  What did ye say?!  How dare ye!  Me beer can stand up to any of that rot they serve at Brewfest!$B$BYou'll pay for this insult, $c!
Whatever advice I can give to aid in your fight against the ogres, you shall have it!
Whatever you need, Brazie Getz! Get it?$B$BAnd I'm not just talkin' about the "legal" stuff, either. WHATEVER YOU NEED, PAL! Anything...
Whatever you're going to ask for, do it quickly.
When Ahune surfaces, will we be ready?
When Hallow's End is over we'll smash all these pumpkins. That'll be the greatest day I've ever known!

When I first arrived, I'd hoped to meet the town's namesake.$B$B<Ros'eleth glances around.>$B$BMost young high elves outgrow the 'I wanna be a Farstrider' phase by the time they're taken as apprentices. Then, it's onto the 'I'm going to be a magister' stage.$B$BI don't think I ever quite outgrew the Farstrider phase, to be honest. No one dreams of growing up to be a seamstress, but we can't have the Farstriders running around naked, as my mother used to say.

When I first set up my rogue academy in Shattrath, it wasn't nearly this crowded. Then, the refugees started flooding in and the naaru needed every available building to house them.$B$BI've closed the doors to my academy for now, but it's not permanent. I'll find a new place to set up.$B$BThen, a new generation of rogues will learn such staples as the gouge'n grin, combat looting, and blaming someone else for breaking polymorph. And who can forget the central rule of roguery --- real rogues don't feint.
When I grow up I wanna be a tanner!

When I was last in the halls, Talon King Ikiss carried Terokk's Quill with him, as a sign of his authority.$B$BMy brother, Darkweaver Syth, wore Terokk's Mask during our rituals.$B$BAs for the Saga of Terokk, there's no way of knowing exactly where it is, but they usually kept it at the center of one of their rune circles in the great vaulted halls.

When I was young I trained hard to become an anchorite in the priesthood.  Female exarchs were practically unheard of.$B$BNowadays gender matters little - it is courage and conviction that make all the difference.

When he says, 'younger brother,' he fails to mention that we're twins. He's really only older by a couple of minutes.$B$BDon't let that 'rising star' bit of his fool you. I'll never be a trader of the same magnitude that he is.
When it comes to treasure, never be lookin' sideways at lootin' someone else's junk. Stolen goods be much sweeter, ya? But free is free, no matta how it got that way!
When the tournament starts, all will see the Forsaken emerge triumphant.

When you get a ram, you also get the reins. These aren't your grandma's reins though, you've gotta use them!$b$bJust loosen up on the reins a few times to build up some speed.  Keep on loosening up and GIDDYUP!  You'll be flying!$b$bBut the faster he goes the quicker he'll get tired. So you have to be careful.$B
When you next go to the Molten Core, kill a Firelord for me, will you?
When you run with Razak's Roughriders, you learn a thing or two about following orders.$B$BThe first thing is that you fight until you die.  The second thing is, see the first thing.

When you take one of these tasks, we'll lend you a ram. It's a loan, so it won't last forever. The ram may seem slow, but just ease up on the reins a bit and he'll pick up the pace.$b$bOur rams love apples. We've put a few bushels of apples out along the way, so make sure to stop by. Eating apples will make your ram forget about how tired he's been getting.
Where could she possibly be? I sent my apprentice, Shatharia, to the Underlight Mines to the west quite some time ago. We need those ore samples back, and fast or our experiment is going to fail!
Where did everyone go?
Where the Eye of the Prophets rested for millenia, only an empty niche remains.
Which battleground are you interested in?
Which battleground do you seek your glory in?

While Nesingwary's advances upon the wildlife of Northrend has been halted, it is only a matter of time before he attempts another incursion. You must remain vigilant, $N!$B$BAbove all else, do not give in to whatever temptations may be set before you... The demon will attempt to charm you. When it happens, you must resist!
While exploration in these new lands is no doubt important, you mustn't forsake Azeroth! We need you now more than ever in the fight against the Defilers. Those resources must be secured!
While nothing can change the past, time can heal all wounds. Thank you for showing me that it is possible, $N. I wish you well.
While the focus of the Sha'tar remains on Shadowmoon Valley and Illidan, we cannot ignore the threat that Kael'thas Sunstrider presents.
While we have much to teach the other races of the Alliance, we have as much to learn from them.  Keep your eyes, ears and mind open, $c.

Whitereach Post is something of an unintended stop for me, to put it mildly. My clients are counting on me to deliver my wares and I'm starting to wonder if I'm going to make it in time with all the delays involved.
Who are you?  I feel... so... cold.
Who are you?  What do you want here?
Whoah! You really want buy from us?
Why da Scourge let you walk around in here, mon?
Why did you do this to us?
Why is everyone looking at me as if I crashed the ship?
Why isn't the Outland called Draenor anymore?

Why you're just the $c I was looking for! I'm testing a new rocket-powered flying device, and I need your help!$B$BJust take one of these harnesses and put it on under your armor.  Hit the button on the side, and BOOM, off you go.$B$BDon't go trying to steal my work though. Each of these babies is fitted with a Transponster 8000 linked to the one in my hand. If you get too far from me the Transponster will shut down the main rocket and you'll be unable to lift off until you return.$B$BNow where did I put those liability forms?
Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!
Will the Horde grant me the chance to battle the Scourge?
With a good portion of their demons slain, the Legion will think twice about attacking our lumber camp again.  However, I still sense demonic evil stirring.
With enough money, I could take over the world...
With new enemies on our doorsteps, we must not allow our ancient enemies to take advantage of our situation!

With the Lich King fleeing in fear of Fordring armed with the Ashbringer, we were able to easily wrest Ebon Hold from the remaining Scourge forces.$B$BThat didn't settle things between us and the Scarlet Crusade, however.$B$BAs the Forsaken have learned the hard way, the Scarlets cannot seem to differentiate between us and the Scourge.$B$BWe think on our own, we have our own motivations, we have almost all of the qualities of the living, and yet to them, we are no different than the mindless slaves of the Lich King.$B$BMistakenly they think we will roll over and play dead.
With the Light's blessing and your help, $N, the Defias are no longer a threat.$B$BBut we're a long way from Westfall up here, and if we don't win this battle, there may not be a home to return to.
With the Warsong Offensive here in Icecrown Citadel, victory is within our grasp! The death of the Lich King will bring glory to the Horde!
With the help of our new taunka allies, the Northrend will belong to the Horde.
With you and your people as allies, we have decided to stay on this island and rebuild. Elune bless you, hero.$B$BWhile the sadness still comes and goes, I think we will survive.$B
With your help, we might be able to win this thing!

Without delivery of the Underlight ore in such a timely fashion, our research would have failed.$B$BJust wait until Shatharia shows her head here again. I've got some interesting tasks for her, you can be sure of it!

Without knowledge of the incantations required to unite the two parts, Lord Vyletongue was unable to use the scepter. However, now that I am free of the curse of Vyletongue's corruption, I will be able to assist you, if you'd like to bring me the two parts -- both the head and the rod of the scepter.

Woah, woah, woah! Keep it down, $N. Keep it down!$B$B<Blast looks around.>$B$BWe don't want those frosty vrykul noticing us, now do we?$B$BWhat do you think of my jumpbot? I based it off of the mechagnome. Pretty slick, huh?
Woo Ping is the master of polearms. He trains his students at Weller's Arsenal in Stormwind.

Word got back to me through channels concerning Lady Sylvanas's reaction to you and the recovery of her necklace. I still think you did the right thing; don't worry too much about how the lady reacted.$B$BNow, state your business.
Word travels fast in this circle.  Thanks for restocking the supplies!
Working with this technology is a huge headache.  Everything is constructed in such an alien way.
Would a tauren paladin be a holy cow?
Would you like to hear a story?
Wow, you totally bombed out there. Let's think of that as a rehearsal, shall we? Ready to go out again?
Ya be havin' me gratitude, $c.$b$bIf there be anythin' I can be doin' fer yeh, just say so.

Ya may know a thing or two about handlin' animals, but have ya ever taken ta the skies? We Wildhammers know how ta ride the wind with the best of 'em. Fer a small fee, if ya've got the mettle, I'll train ya good and proper.
Yah, mon, this be the time to be glad of life and spring. Ya collect lots of eggs yet?

Ye have my approval $N, ye can forge blades better than any I've trained in years. If ye want to make a real weapon though, ye need to talk with Myolor Sunderfury. That Dwarf will set ya on the right path.
Ye'll find the battlemasters around the war table in the Hall of Arms.
Yeah, yeah, I'm feeling better, but I kind of like it down here.

Yeah, yeah... welcome to my station.$B$BSo, what do you think?  Pretty nifty what we've done here, wouldn't you say?$B$BMakes me glad to be rid of those stuffy elves at Sylvanaar anyway.$B$BMake yourself useful around here; there're plenty of experiments and whatnot to help out with.
Yeah, you know a few things! If you wanna' learn more you're gonna' have to talk to Georgio Bolero in Stormwind.
Yeah?
Yep, I've been stuck here for as long as I can remember.$B$BIn my former life, I was an armorer. Perhaps I can fix something for you?
Yer skill is not without merit, but I need to put one last test to ye before I take ye on.
Yes $gsir:ma'am;, this is quite a drink!  Quite a drink indeed!
Yes, $c, what is it?
Yes, $t citizen : citizen;, what matter of import do you have to bring to my attention?

Yes, I am one of the 'Broken'.  I trust that this does not bother you?  Broken or draenei, we must endure the ridicule that some in our society may throw at us.  A better understanding and communication with the elements of this world is all that matters.

Yes, I have seen the shaman you seek. Last I saw her, she was to the west of here. She hides in the hills above the Razormane tribe. If you're clever, you'll be able to find a path to her hut in the hills. It is not too far north of here. That path should allow you to find her without fighting through the quilboar.

Yes, friends. This man was no wizard of Dalaran. His clothes looked quite foreign, and his accent was unfamiliar. All he could mumble about was time this, time that. You'll have to find that wizard and convince him to release me.
Yes, little one?
Yes, my $g son : daughter;?
Yes, the Lich King will fall to our might. We will have our final revenge.$B$BBut first, we will see to it that the plague known as the Scarlet Onslaught comes to an end once and for all!

Yes, well, listen here, $c. I'm older than I look and wise beyond my years. You'd do well not to question me so much.

Look, you don't need to take my word for it. Read the postings on any local bulletin board for yourself. I'm everywhere!$b$bJust do yourself a favor and ignore the ones with 'WANTED' in the title. Simple misunderstandings, I assure you.
Yes. $N. I have located the Forest Lord. We must redouble our efforts! More crystals are needed!
Yes?
Yes?  Darn it all, now I'll have to start over from scratch!
Yes?  What is it?
Yes? What is it?$B$BTime waits for no one!
Yo! Have you heard about the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit?You can find Arena Organizers selling the arena team charters in Gadgetzan and outside the arenas in Nagrand and the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Yo. I'm Vixton Pinchwhistle, official Arena Vendor for the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit. If you've got the rep, I've got the goods that'll make your mouth water.
Yo. Lookin' to get back to the Old World? Fly to Tirisfal Glades in style on the Cloudkisser.
You - come here. Are these blades not the finest quality? Surely you wish to purchase from me. You will not find such workmanship and care wrought into such weapons anywhere else, $r.
You Scourge gunna fail here, mon.
You Scourge not welcome in Zul'Drak!
You a new recruit? That's not standard issue armor.
